parsed.attack: The author has designed the loop out of the product: the medical-POA sibling 'opens the shared statement without an account of their own', so the recipient gets the whole value without installing - that is a feature, not a loop - and the payer is always the single financial-POA holder, exactly one per family, which makes the structural coefficient zero. Even the reading event is monthly, so the slowest cycle in this set governs a mechanism that cannot convert anyone in the first place. What remains is hand-recruitment from elder-law and caregiver forums about a subject - money moving between siblings over a parent's estate - that people specifically will not post about under their own names.
parsed.strongest_defence: The reading sibling is a live prospect precisely because they receive a statement and cannot contribute to it, so converting reader to writer is an in-app upsell the founder fully controls, and r/AgingParents and AgingCare carry enormous volumes of this exact complaint.
parsed.verdict_reason: The named loop is zero by design because the second sibling never installs, but a slow hand-worked caregiver-forum channel remains open.
